name: Prototype: the climb room
body: One wall, two ways up: a pipe and ladder only the player can climb, and a lift and stairs she opens from the ground route.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the six rooms and the crossing: the game feels like an action adventure (grounded movement, challenge from places and small games), not a puzzle platformer.

acceptance_criteria: Climbing the pipe reaches the ledge
Pulling the lever lowers the lift
